Refine the prior blocker: MP Biomedicals explicitly uses CAS 3470-37-9 for the monohydrate, while the same CAS is used for unhydrated calcium salt. Use a distinct local hydrate identity and preserve the supplier CAS as procurement metadata rather than exact global identity. Withdraw anhydrous CID/SMILES/InChI. Formula follows the certificate hemicalcium unit plus one water, doubled to whole calcium stoichiometry. Existing close match to free acid retained as reviewed in #342, not promoted to subsumption.
